newsitem.title: CHINA: China dam firm says no decision yet on generators.
newsitem.headline: China dam firm says no decision yet on generators.

text.p: China will decide the winner of a tender to supply generators for the huge Three Gorges dam in the next two days, and no final decision has been made so far, officials involved in the project said on Friday.

An official in the president's Office of the Yangtze Three Gorges Project Development Corp declined to give details of the prospects of any of the groups bidding to supply 14 generating units for the world's biggest water project.
"We are now in the process of deciding," said the official from the project headquarters in central China.
"We have not yet made the final decision," he said.

Officials had named the groups in the running for the contract as including Siemens AG and GE Canada; Anglo-French group GEC Alsthom; Swedish-Swiss ABB ; a Russian consortium; a Japanese group; and Impsa of Argentina as well as Westinghouse Canada.
